title: Kept time well when I first got it.
text:
Kept time well when I first got it.. Easy to read. I like the colors, too.
But, doesn’t keep time correctly.
Have tried different batteries to no
avail.

product_metadata.title: Maxspace Golden Desk Clock, Retro Vintage Non-Ticking Battery Operated Small Alarm Clock, Quartz Movement HD Glass Metal Silent Table Clock for Bedroom Living Room Indoor Decoration Kids
